output.reason: The release note [ev-1b18f0fe7577] is vague, but the linked issue #19768 [ev-a2adc7495d6b] names the subject: setting up repositories in the `argocd-cm` ConfigMap, the "legacy" way, instead of the newer Secret-based system. It says this support is dropped in 3.0. PR #21249 [ev-c6aabb73469b] closes that issue and changes the repository database code, the declarative-setup docs and the 2.14-3.0 upgrade guide [ev-8d24a3622643], which confirms a 'removed' change. So exposed environments are those that still set up repositories in `argocd-cm`, and if the operator does nothing, those repository settings stop being supported. The evidence does not say whether they are silently ignored or cause an error, and the upgrade-guide text is not shown, so the consequence is partly inferred.
